thread:
maria: Heads-up — Quantum Bridge case study prep. Interview with CTO scheduled Wed 4/9 11:00am PT. Needs: quote approval (Tue EOD PT), localized snippets (FR/DE) for launch post, short tech note for benchmark claims, and asset checklist for webinar follow-up. Draft case doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/quantum-bridge-case (WIP). Can PMs confirm metric source and lead routing after publish? @lee @sam

sam: I’ll own the narrative + publish draft. Can we get a 25–30 word hero quote from the CTO that we can push to social? Prefer something with a clear metric/benefit.

maria: Raw from the interview recorder (timestamp 00:12:34): "We cut inference costs by 42% while shaving 30ms off p99 latency. Redwood made rollout trivial." Is that fine to use or do we need to shorten?

sam: That’s gold, but legal will want backup for the percentages. Also recommend two shorter variants: `We cut inference costs by ~40% and improved p99 latency by ~30ms.` and `Lower costs, faster responses — 40% cost reduction, 30ms p99 improvement.`

taylor: On legal. Please attach the benchmark export or point us to the test run. Any raw data we can review? Claims with precise percentages need a source.

marcus: Confirmed — metrics come from our internal Q3 benchmark (bench_v2/2024-07/results.csv). I can export a PDF snippet for legal. The test used our standard Llama-like workload (batching off, seq len 512).

jen: I’ll handle localization routing. Timeline question: when do you need FR/DE strings? Thu morning? Also will we need localized thumbnails/captions or just headlines?

lee: For demand-gen, we want localized headlines + 1-liners for the webinar landing page and social captions by Thu AM. I’ll coordinate translations and brief the vendor. Also — where do webinar leads land in SFDC? Need campaign ID to wire forms.

maria: Timeline recap for clarity: Tue EOD (4/8) — final hero quote approved by legal; Wed 4/9 11am — interview with CTO (recording); Thu AM — localized headlines + captions; Fri — asset handoff + webinar invite to sales. Does that work?

marcus: Works on my side. Attached proof for legal: `s3://bench-exports/quantum-bridge/2024-07-summary.pdf`. I’ll DM Taylor the export and short methodology note.

taylor: Received — will review and respond Tue morning. If metrics check out, legal ok on wording with a short footnote.

sam: Drafting the social copy now. Proposed hero line for approval (pick one):
```
1) "Quantum Bridge cut inference costs by 42% and reduced p99 latency by 30ms."
2) "40% lower inference costs, 30ms faster p99 latency — how Quantum Bridge accelerated their product."
```
Which variant do we prefer?

lee: Option 2 reads cleaner for ads. :thumbsup:

jen: Localization note — we need final approved English copy before sending to translators. I’ll queue it as soon as Sam posts the approved line.

launch-bot: Calendar invite created — "Quantum Bridge CTO Interview" Wed Apr 9 11:00am PT. Guests: maria, sam, marcus, lee. Recording enabled.

maria: Thanks all. Quick ask for thread: when legal signs off, can someone drop the approved quote into the case doc and mark the `quote_approved` checkbox? Also add the link to the benchmark export under the methodology section.

lee: Routing note: webinar leads will flows to SFDC campaign `CB-2024-QUANTUM-BRIDGE` and trigger automation rule `wg_webinar_followup_v2`. I’ll post the campaign ID and the form endpoint here after I confirm with ops.

sam: Got it. I’ll push a publish-ready draft by Tue noon so legal has time to review. :eyes:

maria: Perfect. If anything slips we’ll push the webinar to next week, but aim to keep cadence. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
